components.label: Engine
components.description: Engine assembly, ignition, fuel trimming and ancillary drive.
inspectionFocus: Check engine light and stored codes
Idle quality and fuel trims
Spark plugs and ignition coils
Compression and leak-down where indicated

components.label: Transmission / gearbox
components.description: Gearbox, clutch or torque converter, and driveline coupling.
inspectionFocus: Check transmission fluid condition and level
Verify shift quality and engagement delays
Scan transmission control codes and live data
Inspect mounts and driveline joints

components.label: Fuel and induction system
components.description: Fuel pump, injectors, intake ducting, EVAP components and airflow measurement.
inspectionFocus: Inspect intake ducting and vacuum connections
Check fuel pressure and injector operation
Inspect EVAP cap, hoses and valves
Review fuel trims and airflow sensor readings

components.label: Cooling system (circulation)
components.description: Coolant circulation, temperature sensing and cooling-fan control.
inspectionFocus: Compare scan-tool temperature with a warm-up trace
Verify coolant level and circulation
Check cooling fan operation
Inspect hoses for leaks after the engine cools

components.label: Thermostat
components.description: Coolant thermostat and its housing; verifies engine warm-up regulation.
inspectionFocus: Compare warm-up trace with specification
Verify thermostat opening temperature
Inspect housing and seating
Check for a thermostat stuck open or closed

components.label: Water pump
components.description: Coolant pump, impeller, drive and associated seals.
inspectionFocus: Inspect pump for leaks and bearing noise
Verify coolant circulation
Check drive belt or pump drive
Look for residue around the pump weep hole

components.label: Radiator
components.description: Radiator core, cap, hoses and front-end airflow path.
inspectionFocus: Inspect core for damage or obstruction
Check cap, hoses and clamps after cooling
Verify coolant level and condition
Check airflow and fan shroud

components.label: Braking system
components.description: Brake discs, calipers, pads and hydraulic circuit.
inspectionFocus: Measure pad and disc wear
Inspect calipers, hoses and fluid
Check ABS codes and sensor wiring
Road-test braking balance where safe

components.label: Front suspension
components.description: Front struts, control arms, ball joints and anti-roll linkage.
inspectionFocus: Inspect struts and mounts for leakage
Check ball joints, bushings and tie-rod ends
Check spring condition and ride height
Perform a suspension play inspection

components.label: Rear suspension
components.description: Rear springs or struts, linkage, bushings and dampers.
inspectionFocus: Check dampers for leakage and response
Inspect bushes and link rods
Check spring condition and ride height
Inspect rear hub and bearing play

components.label: Steering system
components.description: Steering rack, column, linkages and power assistance.
inspectionFocus: Check steering play and free movement
Inspect rack, boots and tie rods
Check power-assist fluid or electric assist faults
Verify wheel alignment after repair

components.label: Battery
components.description: Battery, terminals, grounds and battery monitoring circuit.
inspectionFocus: Load-test the battery
Inspect terminals, grounds and fuses
Check battery age and resting voltage
Verify battery monitoring sensor where fitted

components.label: Alternator / charging
components.description: Alternator output, regulator, accessory drive and charging wiring.
inspectionFocus: Measure charging voltage and alternator output
Check accessory belt condition
Inspect charging wiring and fuses
Check for rigging or regulator faults

components.label: Electrical system
components.description: Fuses, relays, wiring, lighting, control modules and communication faults.
inspectionFocus: Check relevant fuses, relays and grounds
Scan module codes and live data
Inspect wiring and connectors for damage
Verify lighting and warning-lamp operation

components.label: Exhaust system
components.description: Exhaust manifold, pipework, catalysts, muffler and oxygen sensors.
inspectionFocus: Check for exhaust leaks
Review catalyst efficiency codes
Inspect oxygen sensor activity after warm-up
Inspect mounts and pipework corrosion

components.label: Air conditioning
components.description: Compressor, condenser, evaporator, refrigerant circuit and climate controls.
inspectionFocus: Check cabin cooling performance
Inspect compressor operation and belt
Check condenser and evaporator for blockage
Verify refrigerant pressures using approved equipment

components.label: Wheels and tyres
components.description: Road wheels, rims and tyres including tread and pressure.
inspectionFocus: Measure tread depth and check uneven wear
Set tyre pressures to specification
Inspect rims for cracks or damage
Check wheel balance and alignment
